Review baseline: release/3.0 at fb5b59bda429b7545f82072dabe10f8b299432dc.
Classification: review-confirmed defect.

Source task: 01a09c57-236c-7ba3-a07a-8bbe84647d97

2. **P1 — MCP wildcard scopes bypass lease scope limits.**  
   [scope_resolver.ex:85](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/mcp/scope_resolver.ex:85) removes a target requirement when the durable connection contains its wildcard. It does not check whether the lease still grants that wildcard.  
   **Evidence:** With endpoint and tool wildcards on the connection, authorization returned `:ok` when the effective lease contained only `mcp:tools:call`. The requested target had no effective lease grant. This contradicts the declared scope intersection contract. Resources and prompts use the same helper.  
   **Correction:** Check wildcard grants against effective lease scopes. Keep an explicit target or wildcard requirement in the authorization result.

---

Source task: 01a09c57-2619-7251-b3f3-113072d196ce

2. **P1 — Wildcard scopes bypass lease scope limits.**  
   [scope_resolver.ex:85](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/mcp/scope_resolver.ex:85)

   When the connection has a wildcard, the resolver removes the target scope requirement. Authorization then cannot detect that the lease excludes that wildcard. A lease containing only `mcp:tools:call` passed authorization for an arbitrary endpoint and tool. Resources, prompts, completion, and sessions use the same helper.

   **Correction:** Require the wildcard scope instead of returning an empty requirement. Check it against the effective lease scopes.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: MCP wildcard scopes bypass lease scope limits
